trainingSourceExecution: Immutable source snapshot inside this run; no patching the running trainer.
restartBasis: User approved implementing parameterized power-aware checkpoint/resume and continued the full training goal. Fresh single-epoch run uses the same frozen action-v4 data and recipe; the old adapter-only checkpoint cannot restore optimizer/RNG state.
integrationFixes: Charging/starting states wait on a live process rather than prematurely failing the evaluation handoff.
Handoff uses actual full-epoch/checkpoint/roundtrip verifier; trainer result has phase/steps, not status=completed.
Evaluation inherits resource sample interval; two-second liveness checks no longer read battery each time.
Report output remains beside the evaluation directory, not inside the final asset root.
scope: Immutable admission snapshot only. Live run receipts determine later progress; probe and dev-before are not optimizer updates or model-quality evidence.
